summary_en: This summer, Europe, Asia, and North America experienced record heat, drought, wildfires, and torrential floods. Western Europe had its hottest June and July; wildfires in France forced 220,000 evacuations, and low water levels on the Rhine and other waterways affected shipping and energy supplies.

summary: 8月15日，海杰航运“迪拜塔”号驶离浙江宁波舟山港穿山港区集装箱码头，标志着中欧北极集装箱航线实现常态化运营，为中欧贸易开辟快捷高效、绿色低碳的北向物流大通道。本年度该航线首航船舶国内首靠宁波舟山港，出境后依次停靠英国费利克斯托、荷兰鹿特丹
summary_en: On August 15, the Hai Jie Shipping vessel 'Burj Dubai' departed from the Chuanshan Port Area container terminal of Ningbo Zhoushan Port in Zhejiang, marking the regular operation of the China-Europe Arctic container route and opening a fast, efficient, green and low-carbon northbound logistics corridor for China-Europe trade. This year's first voyage vessel on the route made its first domestic call at Ningbo Zhoushan Port, and after departure will call in turn at Felixstowe, UK, and Rotterdam, Netherlands.
